title: Sandpaper Number Match
engine: custom DOM and Canvas ordered-trace, count, and quantity-match runtime with shared QLOBE screen, input, audio, celebration, and debug modules
shareTitle: Sandpaper Number Match — Trace, Count & Match
description: Trace tactile sandpaper numerals, wake matching sets of sleepy plush stars, and connect written numbers to quantities in a cozy felt quiet-book world.
learningGoals: Practice ordered numeral formation for 1–9 with forgiving finger tracing
Build stable-order and one-to-one counting for sets from 1–10
Connect written numerals with corresponding visual quantities
interactionModel: choose one of three large stitched lesson cards, trace an ordered numeral path or tap tactile star sets, and match a numeral to one of three quantity cards
feedbackModel: a glowing start point and sandy trail model formation, each sleeping star wakes and speaks the next count, gentle misses pulse or wiggle without penalty, and every round ends with a felt rosette, recorded praise, and confetti

modes.title: Trace & Count
modes.skill: ordered numeral formation connected directly to quantity

modes.title: Star Count
modes.skill: stable-order counting and one-to-one correspondence through 10

modes.title: Find a Match
modes.skill: matching written numerals to close visual quantities
